_help: Ads on the Rapid+ Blog. 'house' = our own products, shown in the slots listed under 'slots' (several names rotate across pages). 'ads' = paid ads; a live paid ad for a slot replaces the house ad there. Slots: home-top, home-mid, sidebar, category-top, article-mid, article-end. Paid ad fields: id, active, slot, sponsor, title (max 60), text (max 120), cta, url, image (1200x630 or GIF/WebP), from/to (YYYY-MM-DD). After editing run: node tools/build-blog.js and push.
